0022600240.text: The Celtics (10-2, first in the Atlantic and first in the East) host the Dallas Mavericks (7-4, ninth in the West) on a five-game winning streak for Boston, which is 5-0 at home, while Dallas enters on a three-game streak. Paul George is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision for Boston, while Dallas will be without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). Boston won both 2025-26 meetings 2-0, including a 120-100 win in Boston on March 6, 2026, and the two teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27.
